content.short: Wave is a Telegram-integrated ecosystem on Sui featuring a GasLess wallet and AI trading tools.
content.description:
Wave is a pioneering decentralized ecosystem built natively on the high-performance Sui blockchain, designed to provide millions of users with a seamless gateway to Web3 through the Telegram messaging platform. The platform features the Wave Wallet, a self-custodial digital asset manager that utilizes an innovative "GasLess" protocol, allowing participants to interact with dApps and execute trades without holding native gas tokens. Wave also includes AI-enhanced trading tools and auto-sniping bots to provide users with a professional-grade trading experience on-chain.

Beyond its wallet and DEX capabilities, the ecosystem is anchored by the Ocean Game, a viral social-tech experience where users can earn rewards and exclusive digital assets. Powered by the OCEAN utility token, Wave serves as a vital liquidity hub and onboarding portal for the Sui network. Through its commitment to user-centric design and the integration of cutting-edge AI technologies, Wave is building the essential framework for a more accessible and rewarding decentralized social economy.
